summary: Return the live URLSearchParams object associated with a URL and keep URL/query mutations synchronized.

semantics.identity: repeated getter calls return the same associated URLSearchParams object
semantics.url_to_params: setting URL.search updates the associated list
semantics.params_to_url: mutating the list updates URL query serialization
semantics.encoding: URLSearchParams form encoding can change href serialization

caveats: Do not lower searchParams to a detached dictionary snapshot.

tests.name: params mutation updates URL
tests.input: const u=new URL("https://e.test/?a=1"); const p=u.searchParams; p.set("a","2"); console.log(u.search,p===u.searchParams);
